<TITLE>EX-10.2</TITLE>

 <BODY BGCOLOR="WHITE" STYLE="line-height:Normal">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="right"><B>Exhibit 10.2 </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>TCW SPECIALTY LENDING LLC </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center"><B>INVESTMENT ADVISORY AND MANAGEMENT AGREEMENT </B></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">THIS AGREEMENT (this &#8220;<U>Agreement</U>&#8221;) is made as of [&#9679;], 2026 by and between TCW SPECIALTY LENDING LLC, a Delaware
limited liability company (the &#8220;<U>Company</U>&#8221;), and TCW ASSET MANAGEMENT COMPANY LLC, a Delaware limited liability company (the &#8220;<U>Adviser</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Company is a newly organized <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">closed-end</FONT> management investment fund that intends to elect
to be treated as a business development company (&#8220;<U>BDC</U>&#8221;) under the Investment Company Act of 1940, as amended (&#8220;<U>1940 Act</U>&#8221;); </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Adviser is engaged in the business of providing investment advice and is registered as an investment adviser under the Investment
Advisers Act of 1940, as amended (the &#8220;<U>Advisers Act</U>&#8221;); </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Company desires to retain the Adviser to render
investment advisory and management services to the Company in the manner and on the terms hereinafter set forth; and </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">WHEREAS, the Adviser
is willing to perform such services on the terms and conditions hereinafter set forth; </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises
and the covenants hereinafter contained and for other good and valuable consideration, the receipt and adequacy of which is hereby acknowledged, the Company and the Adviser hereby agree as follows: </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">1. <U>Definitions</U>. For the purposes of this Agreement, the terms &#8220;assignment,&#8221; &#8220;interested person,&#8221; and
&#8220;majority of the outstanding voting securities&#8221; shall have their respective meanings as defined in the 1940 Act and the rules and regulations adopted by the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (&#8220;<U>SEC</U>&#8221;) thereunder,
and the term &#8220;brokerage and research services&#8221; shall have the meaning given in the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and the rules and regulations adopted by the SEC thereunder, subject, however, in all cases to such exemptions as may be
granted by the SEC, such interpretive positions as may be taken by the SEC, and such interpretive or no action positions as may be taken by the SEC staff. The capitalized terms used without definition in this Agreement, unless otherwise indicated,
have the respective meanings specified in the Amended and Restated Limited Liability Company Agreement of the Company (as the same may be amended from time to time, the &#8220;<U>LLC Agreement</U>&#8221;). </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">2. <U>Appointment</U>. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">a. The
Company engages the Adviser to provide investment advisory and management services to the Company. This engagement is for the period and on the terms set forth in this Agreement. The Adviser hereby accepts such engagement and agrees to render the
services and to assume the obligations set forth in this Agreement, for the compensation provided below. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">b. The Adviser, subject to the
prior approval of the Company&#8217;s board of directors (the &#8220;<U>Board</U>&#8221;) and, to the extent required, the Members, may from time to time enter into one or more <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-advisory</FONT> agreements with
other investment advisers (each a &#8220;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Adviser</FONT></U>&#8221;) as the Adviser may believe to be particularly fitted to assist it in the performance of this Agreement; <U>provided, however</U>, that the
compensation of any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Adviser</FONT> shall be paid by the Adviser and that the Adviser shall be as fully responsible to the Company for the acts and omissions of any
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Sub-Adviser</FONT> as it is for its own acts and omissions. Any <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">sub-advisory</FONT> agreement entered into by the Adviser shall be in accordance with the requirements of the 1940 Act
and other applicable federal and state law. </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">3. <U>Advisory and Management Services</U>. The Company hereby engages the Adviser to act as
the investment adviser to the Company and to manage the investment and reinvestment of the assets of the Company, subject to the supervision of the Board, for the period and upon the terms herein set forth, (a)&nbsp;in accordance with the investment
objective, policies and restrictions that are set forth in the Company&#8217;s registration statement on Form 10 (and as the same shall be amended from time to time, the &#8220;<U>Registration Statement</U>&#8221;) and in accordance with the
investment objective, policies and restrictions that are set forth in the Company&#8217;s offering documents, as it may be amended from time to time; (b)&nbsp;in accordance with all other applicable federal and state laws, rules and regulations, and
the LLC Agreement; and (c)&nbsp;in accordance with the 1940 Act. Without limiting the generality of the foregoing, the Adviser shall, during the term and subject to the provisions of this Agreement: (i)&nbsp;formulate and implement the
Company&#8217;s investment program; (ii)&nbsp;determine the composition of the portfolio of the Company, the nature and timing of the changes therein and the manner of implementing such changes; (iii)&nbsp;identify/source, research, evaluate and
negotiate the structure of the investments made by the Company (including performing due diligence on prospective Portfolio Companies); (iv) close, monitor and administer the Company&#8217;s investments, including the exercise of any rights in its
capacity as a lender; (v)&nbsp;determine the securities and other assets that the Company will originate, purchase, retain, or sell; (vi)&nbsp;place orders for the purchase or sale of portfolio securities for the Company&#8217;s account with
broker-dealers selected by the Adviser; (vii)&nbsp;pay such expenses as are incurred by it in connection with providing the foregoing services as provided in Section&nbsp;4 below; (viii)&nbsp;coordinate with the Administrator; and (ix)&nbsp;provide
the Company with such other investment advisory, research, and related services as the Company may, from time to time, reasonably require for the investment of its funds, including providing operating and managerial assistance to the Company and its
portfolio companies as required. Subject to the supervision of the Board, the Adviser shall have the power and authority on behalf of the Company to effectuate its investment decisions for the Company, including the execution and delivery of all
documents relating to the Company&#8217;s investments and the placing of orders for other purchase or sale transactions on behalf of the Company. In the event that the Company determines to acquire debt financing, the Adviser will arrange for such
financing on the Company&#8217;s behalf, subject to the oversight and approval of the Board. If it is necessary or appropriate for the Adviser to make investments on behalf of the Company through a subsidiary of the Company or other special purpose
vehicle, the Adviser shall have authority to create or arrange for the creation of such subsidiary of the Company or other special purpose vehicle and to make such investments through such subsidiary of the Company or other special purpose vehicle
(in accordance with the 1940 Act). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">4. <U>Reimbursement of Certain Expenses</U>. In addition to the Management Fee and Incentive Fee
described below, the Adviser is entitled to the reimbursement of certain expenses incurred on behalf of the Company to the extent described in the Administration Agreement by and between the Company and TCW Asset Management Company LLC (as
Administrator). </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">5. <U>Management Fee</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">a. The Company will pay to the Advisor an annual management fee (the &#8220;<U>Management Fee</U>&#8221;) quarterly in arrears calculated as
follows: 0.3125% (i.e., 1.25%<I>&nbsp;per annum</I>) of the average&nbsp;net assets&nbsp;of the Company, with the average determined based on the&nbsp;net assets&nbsp;of the Company as of the end of the three most recently completed calendar months.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">b. Installments of the Management Fee payable for any partial month, quarter, or any Common Unit issuances or repurchases by the Company
during a calendar month or quarter shall be <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pro-rated</FONT> for the actual number of days in such period. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">6. <U>Incentive Fee</U>. The Company shall pay to the Advisor an incentive fee (the &#8220;<U>Incentive Fee</U>&#8221;) quarterly in arrears
in two parts as follows<I>: </I> </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">a. <I>Incentive Fee Based on Income.</I> </P>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="16%">&nbsp;</TD>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">No incentive fee based on <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Incentive</FONT> Fee Net Investment Income
Returns (as defined below) in any calendar quarter in which the Company&#8217;s <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Incentive</FONT> Fee Net </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top">
Investment Income Returns do not exceed the hurdle rate of 1.50% per quarter (6.0% annualized) (the &#8220;<U>Hurdle Rate</U>&#8221;); </TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(B)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">100% of the dollar amount of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Incentive</FONT> Fee Net Investment
Income Returns with respect to that portion of such <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Incentive</FONT> Fee Net Investment Income Returns, if any, that exceeds the Hurdle Rate but is less than a rate of return of 1.71% per quarter (6.86%
annualized) (the &#8220;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT></U>&#8221;). The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> is meant to provide the Advisor with approximately 12.5% of the Company&#8217;s <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Incentive</FONT> Fee Net Investment Income Returns as if a Hurdle Rate did not apply if this net investment income exceeds 1.71% in any calendar quarter; and </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="font-size:6pt;margin-top:0pt;margin-bottom:0pt">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE; font-family:Times New Roman; font-size:10pt" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR style = "page-break-inside:avoid">
<TD WIDTH="16%">&nbsp;</TD>
<TD WIDTH="6%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left">(C)</TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P STYLE=" margin-top:0pt ; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman; " ALIGN="left">12.5% of the dollar amount of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Incentive</FONT> Fee Net Investment
Income Returns, if any, that exceed a rate of return of 1.71% (6.86% annualized). This reflects that once the Hurdle Rate is reached and the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Catch-up</FONT> is achieved, 12.5% of all
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Pre-Incentive</FONT> Fee Net Investment Income Returns thereafter are payable to the Advisor. </P></TD></TR></TABLE>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6pt; margin-bottom:0pt; margin-left:22%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">&#8220;Pre-Incentive</FONT> Fee Net Investment Income Returns&#8221; means, as the context requires, either
the dollar value of, or percentage rate of return on, the value of the Company&#8217;s net assets in accordance with generally accepted accounting principles in the United States (&#8220;<U>GAAP</U>&#8221;) at the end of the immediately preceding
quarter from interest income, dividend income and any other income (including any other fees (other than fees for providing managerial assistance), such as commitment, origination, structuring, diligence and consulting fees or other fees that the
Company receives from portfolio companies) accrued during the calendar quarter, minus the Company&#8217;s operating expenses accrued for the quarter. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">b. <I>Incentive Fee Based on Capital Gains</I>. Payable at the end of each calendar year in arrears, 12.5% of cumulative realized capital
gains from inception through the end of such calendar year, computed net of all realized capital losses and unrealized capital depreciation on a cumulative basis, as calculated in accordance with GAAP, less the aggregate amount of any previously
paid capital gains incentive fees. In no event will the capital gains incentive fee payable pursuant to this Agreement be in excess of the amount permitted by the Advisers Act, including Section&nbsp;205 thereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">c. <I><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</FONT> Incentive Fee</I>. A <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">spin-off</FONT> incentive fee
will be payable to the Adviser in respect of the exchanged units (the &#8220;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</FONT> Incentive Fee</U>&#8221;) on or immediately following the Initial Closing Date (the &#8220;<U><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</FONT> Incentive Fee Payment Date</U>&#8221;). The <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</FONT> Incentive Fee will be calculated as of March&nbsp;31, 2026 (the
&#8220;<U><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</FONT> Incentive Fee Calculation Date</U>&#8221;) and will equal the amount of Incentive Fee that would be payable to the Adviser if (A)&nbsp;all of the Company&#8217;s investments were liquidated
for their current value as of the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</FONT> Incentive Fee Calculation Date, (B)&nbsp;the proceeds from such liquidation were used to pay all of the Company&#8217;s outstanding liabilities, and (C)&nbsp;the
remainder were distributed to Common Unitholders and paid as Incentive Fee. The Company will make the <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</FONT> Incentive Fee payment in cash as soon as reasonably practicable following the <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Spin-Off</FONT> Incentive Fee Payment Date. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">7. <U>Payment of Expenses and Fees to the Adviser upon
Removal</U>. Upon the termination of this Agreement, the former Adviser or its estate or legal representatives shall be entitled to receive from the Company (a)&nbsp;any reimbursements of expenses due and owing to it by the Company; <U>provided,
however</U>, that the Adviser shall be responsible for any expenses it incurs in connection with such removal, and (b)&nbsp;accrued and unpaid Management Fees and Incentive Fees, in each case computed through the effective date of the removal on a <FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">pro-rated</FONT> basis. The right of the Adviser, its estate or legal representatives to the payment of said amounts shall be subject to any claim for damages which the Company or any Member may have against the Adviser,
its estate or legal representatives in connection with such removal. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">8. <U>Services Not Exclusive</U>. Nothing contained in this
Agreement shall prevent the Adviser or any affiliated Person of the Adviser from acting as investment adviser or manager for any other Person, firm or corporation (including any other investment company), whether or not the investment objectives or
policies of any such other Person, firm or corporation are similar to those of the Company, and shall not in any way bind or restrict the </P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
Adviser or any such affiliated Person from buying, selling or trading any securities or commodities for their own accounts or for the account of others for whom the Adviser or any such affiliated
Person may be acting. While information and recommendations supplied to the Company shall, in the Adviser&#8217;s judgment, be appropriate under the circumstances and in light of the investment objectives and policies of the Company, they may be
different from the information and recommendations supplied by the Adviser or its affiliates to other investment companies, funds and advisory accounts. The Company shall be entitled to equitable treatment under the circumstances in receiving
information, recommendations and any other services, but the Company recognizes that it is not entitled to receive preferential treatment as compared with the treatment given by the Adviser to any other investment company, fund or advisory account.
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">9. <U>Portfolio Transactions and Brokerage</U>. To the extent brokers or dealers are utilized in portfolio transactions for the Company,
the Adviser shall endeavor to obtain on behalf of the Company the best overall terms available. In assessing the best overall terms available for any transaction, the Adviser shall consider all factors it deems relevant, including the breadth of the
market in the security, the price of the security, the financial condition and execution capability of the broker or dealer, and the reasonableness of the commission, if any, both for the specific transaction and on a continuing basis. In evaluating
the best overall terms available and in selecting the broker or dealer to execute a particular transaction, the Adviser may also consider the &#8220;brokerage and research services&#8221; provided to the Company and/or other accounts over which the
Adviser or an affiliate of the Adviser exercises investment discretion. The Adviser is authorized to pay a broker or dealer which provides such brokerage and research services a commission for executing a portfolio transaction for the Company which
is in excess of the amount of commission another broker or dealer would have charged for effecting that transaction if, but only if, the Adviser determines in good faith that such commission is reasonable in relation to the value of the brokerage
and research services provided by such broker or dealer viewed in terms of that particular transaction or in terms of the overall responsibilities of the Adviser to the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">10. <U>Books and Records</U>. In compliance with the requirements of Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">31a-3</FONT> under the 1940 Act,
the Adviser agrees that all records that it maintains for the Company are the property of the Company and further agrees to surrender promptly to the Company any of such records upon the Company&#8217;s request. The Adviser further agrees to
preserve for the periods prescribed by Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">31a-2</FONT> under the 1940 Act the records required to be maintained by Rule <FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">31a-1</FONT> under the 1940 Act. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">11. <U>Limitation of Liability</U>. Neither the Adviser, nor any director, officer, agent or employee of the Adviser, shall be liable or
responsible to the Company or any of its Members for (a)&nbsp;any mistake in judgment, (b)&nbsp;any act performed or omission made by such Person, or (c)&nbsp;losses due to the mistake, action, inaction or negligence of other agents of the Company
(x)&nbsp;if such Person did not act in bad faith, and (y)&nbsp;if such conduct did not constitute willful misfeasance, gross negligence, or reckless disregard of the duties involved in the conduct of such Person&#8217;s respective position. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">The Adviser shall be indemnified by the Company as an Indemnitee in accordance with the terms of 11.2 of the LLC Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">12. <U>Nature of Relationship</U>. The Company and the Adviser are not partners or joint venturers with each other and nothing herein shall be
construed so as to make them such partners or joint venturers or impose any liability as such on either of them. The Adviser is an independent contractor and, except as expressly provided or authorized in this Agreement, shall have no authority to
act for or represent the Company. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">13. <U>Duration and Termination</U>. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">a. This Agreement shall become effective upon its execution and shall continue in effect until two years from the date hereof, provided it is
approved by the vote of a &#8220;majority of the outstanding voting securities&#8221; of the Company. Thereafter, this Agreement shall continue in effect from
<FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap"><FONT STYLE="white-space:nowrap">year-to-year,</FONT></FONT> provided its continuance is specifically approved at least annually (a)&nbsp;by vote of a &#8220;majority of the outstanding voting securities&#8221; of
the Company or by vote of the Board, and (b)&nbsp;by vote of a majority of the Independent Directors, cast in person at a meeting called for the purpose of voting on such approval. The Company (either by vote of its Board or by vote
</P>
</DIV></Center>


<p style="margin-top:1em; margin-bottom:0em; page-break-before:always"> </p>
<HR SIZE="3" style="COLOR:#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">


<Center><DIV STYLE="width:8.5in" align="left">
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">
of a &#8220;majority of the outstanding voting securities&#8221; of the Company) may, at any time and without payment of any penalty, terminate this Agreement upon 60 days&#8217; written notice
to the Adviser. This Agreement shall automatically and immediately terminate in the event of its &#8220;assignment.&#8221; The Adviser may terminate this Agreement without payment of any penalty on 60 days&#8217; written notice to the Company. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:9%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">b. Notwithstanding the termination or expiration of this Agreement, the Adviser shall be entitled to any amounts owed under this Agreement
through the date of termination or expiration and Section&nbsp;11 shall continue in force and effect and apply to the Administrator and all Indemnified Parties as and to the extent applicable. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">14. <U>Notices</U>. Any notice under this Agreement shall be given in writing, addressed and delivered to the party to this Agreement entitled
to receive such notice at such address as such party may designate in writing and shall be deemed to have been given when personally delivered, mailed by certified mail, return receipt requested, sent by reliable overnight courier, or transmitted by
electronic facsimile or electronic mail to the principal office of the Adviser or the Company, as the case may be. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">15. <U><FONT
STYLE="white-space:nowrap">Non-waiver</FONT> of Rights</U>. Nothing contained in this Agreement shall constitute a waiver by the Company of any of its legal rights under applicable U.S. federal securities laws or any other laws whose applicability
is not permitted to be contractually waived. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">16. <U>Amendment</U>. This Agreement may be modified or amended only by a writing signed by
the parties hereto, <U>provided, however</U>, that the parties shall not amend this Agreement in a manner that is inconsistent with, or would result in a breach of, the LLC Agreement. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">17. <U>Governing Law</U>. This Agreement shall be construed in accordance with the laws of the State of New York (without giving effect to
principles of conflict of laws of the State of New York) and the applicable provisions of the 1940 Act. To the extent applicable law of the State of New York, or any of the provisions herein conflict with applicable provisions of the 1940 Act, the
latter shall control. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">18. <U>Sole Agreement</U>. This Agreement reflects the sole understanding of the parties hereto with respect to the
subject matter hereof and supersedes and replaces all agreements between the Company and the Adviser with respect to the subject matter hereof. </P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">19. <U>Counterparts</U>. This Agreement may be signed in any number of counterparts, each of which shall be deemed to be an original but all
of which taken together shall constitute one and the same agreement. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; text-indent:4%; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman">20. <U>Severability</U>. In the event that any provision or portion
of this Agreement is determined to be invalid, illegal or unenforceable for any reason, in whole or in part, the remaining provisions or portion of this Agreement shall be unaffected thereby and shall remain in full force and effect to the fullest
extent permitted by applicable law. </P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12pt; margin-bottom:0pt; font-size:10pt; font-family:Times New Roman" ALIGN="center">[SIGNATURE PAGE TO FOLLOW] </P>
